reason: Suspending the last-but-one active system admin by the vault path is refused (the admin_quorum_min_two trigger raises, nothing changes, the target keeps working), but the CLI answers `failed: Error` with exit 1 instead of `refused (quorum)`: identity/admin-status.ts reads err.constraint from the thrown error, while drizzle wraps the Postgres error in `cause`; common/db-errors.ts already unwraps it. The refusal is correct, only its message is not.
